findings.issue: If a valid bed clip is replaced by one that is too short (<8 s) or whose length can't be read, the picker shows the new clip and a warning but never clears settings.musicClip, so the episode still renders with the OLD clip's soundtrack. The slot and the value disagree.
findings.evidence: The useEffect only calls onChange on success; the slot's onChange calls onChange(undefined) only when the slot is emptied (v falsy). The value line is hidden while `problem` is set, so the stale value is invisible.
findings.fix: Call onChange(undefined) when the length check fails (or when a new upload starts).

findings.area: Notes about the split (src/server/shorts.ts notesFor, src/server/mixed-media.ts planInput)
findings.issue: The 'Original sound: … your GPU splits the clip's sound first (free)' note can show when no split is planned. Shorts' notesFor checks only separates(engine, sound), not source.hasAudio (planStitch returns early for a silent clip). Mixed Media uses info.hasAudio !== false while planMixed splits only when source.hasAudio is truthy, so an unknown hasAudio gives the note with no split. Genjutsu and Remove object check hasAudio correctly.
findings.evidence: Traced by reading the code. In the UIs the field is disabled for a silent clip, but a choice made before switching to a silent clip stays in state and soundBody still sends it.

findings.area: Faceless clip bed planning (src/lib/catalog/faceless.ts buildEpisodeGraph; src/server/faceless.ts notesFor)
findings.issue: The whole bed clip is split even when it is much longer than the film (a 10-minute clip for a 1-minute episode runs DBS on all 10 minutes; there is no trim before the split). The estimate notes run musicPlan on oss-dbs-separate, so they never say the clip is looped with a crossfade.
findings.evidence: The music step has inputs.video = clip.url and sourceDuration = clip.duration. notesFor calls musicPlan(getModel(m.music)…) and m.music is SPLIT_MODEL, which has no MUSIC_MAX or durations, so bed = ceil(seconds) and no loop note is made.
